specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable seamless square ground material texture for an existing 2D WWII overhead hex tank game. Create ONLY one flat olive meadow ground texture filling the entire SQUARE image. No hexagon, no frame, no tile border, no vignette, no object shadow, no text, no transparent margins. Perfectly vertical overhead. Simplified hand-drawn 2D strategy-game art matching a tiny olive tank sprite with sparse dark contour details. Broad flat muted olive patches close to #979A62 and #8C9259, a few khaki exposed-earth patches, ONLY about 12 small simple grass tufts scattered over the entire square, no tiny individual grass blades, no foliage closeups, no photographic textures, no noise/grain. Low contrast and flat light so the tank sprites stand out. This material will be sampled across multiple contiguous map cells so edge colors must match and be uniform, all four edges seamlessly tile, no distinct features cut off at edges. Aim deliberately simpler than the reference tank. Reference image 1 tank is STYLE reference only, never draw a tank. Reference image 2 is approved map STYLE reference only; produce just the olive meadow substrate without roads rivers buildings or trees.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production source image for a 2D WWII top-down hex tank game. Match approved reference 1 map style: simple flat color blocks, restrained sparse outlines, muted colors, low contrast ground, deliberately low detail to match tiny olive Sherman sprites. NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D, NOT isometric, no tiny noise or grain, no watercolor paper grain, no microscopic detail. Absolutely vertical overhead orthographic view. No text, no labels, no border, no hexagon frame, no vignette. Full square seamless ground material texture, edge to edge. Muted warm khaki compacted dirt (#B4A17B). Broad nearly flat patches, about 8 tiny sparse pebbles across entire image, very restrained scuffs. No tracks, no road lines, no vegetation, no objects. All four edges must repeat seamlessly. Used for road surfaces and bare ground.
